kill-fixture.scope: Explicit KillSingle fixture and bounded ragdoll capture only; it is not ordinary lethal damage.

limits: Exact directEnemy source wolfA, CEL enWolfA(Clone), motion renderer wolf01 and source renderer 121142 only. This archive grants no inheritance to another wolf source or renderer topology.

The native pass action preserved enemy HP58 and hero HP995 while recording AttackProf, attackProf_wolf, zero damage and HarmlessAttack. This is sampled native gameplay under the survival fixture, not a balance claim.

The ordinary zero-focus attack used the native bluntSmithHammer without a skill cap or damage fixture and produced native Damaged for 8 HP, from 58 to 50, followed by damaged_wolf. The disposable party maximum-HP fortification remained active for test survival and is not representative hero balance.

Two later sampled native attack_wolf sequences recorded a zero-damage SteadFast response and a 4-damage response against the hero, whose HP changed from 995 to 991. These are sampled actions rather than exhaustive wolf animation coverage.
The explicit KillSingle fixture reduced Ashfang from 50 to 0 HP with recorded native 1000 damage and a Death trigger. It is fixture death evidence, not ordinary lethal gameplay.

The source has m_DoRagdoll true with 14 active rigid bodies. They remain kinematic through frame 26; at frame 27 the animator disables and all 14 bodies become dynamic. Measured motion is nonzero from frames 28 through 48 and zero from frame 49 through frame 119.

All three captures retain the requested 120 frames. The exact renderer remains active, enabled, reported visible and identity-stable through all 360 frames. The sampled settled pose persists behind the native loot sequence, but this boundary does not establish general corpse lifetime, cleanup causality or final disposal.
One guarded native Collect action succeeded and strict Ready succeeded at dungeon level 0, room 2, with one active Ready button.

Twenty-four selected original PNGs were reviewed. Native effects, combat UI, foreground hero overlap, fixed-camera perspective, loot UI and late depth blur limit fine inspection in stated frames; the remaining 336 capture PNGs are preserved by hash but were not individually reviewed.

The profile preserves native CEL scale 1.0. Its Standard matWolfA material uses the authored ashfang_basecolor.png main texture while retaining the native wolfA_e emission map and native emission color. This route does not establish a base-color-only material result, portrait pixels, other cameras, other resolutions or all-angle culling.

This isolated dungeon trial does not prove every wolf animation, collision, alternate materials, long-session resource lifetime, inheritance to another wolf source, full campaign progression or finished-art acceptance.
